verdict.rationale: Raygun's docs show events carry custom tags, since errors can be filtered and segmented by custom tags. User context is implied by prioritizing errors by users affected, and the stack trace arrives with environment, browser, version and host data. Nothing in the evidence documents breadcrumbs or an SDK API for attaching user context and tags to each event. Missing for 10: breadcrumbs support, explicit SDK documentation for setting user context and custom tags per event, independent or hands-on corroboration.
